chat.welcomeMessage:
Salaam! 👋 Anigu waxaan ahay kaaliyahaaga beeraha.

Waxaan kaa caawin karaa:
• Dalagyada, khudaarta, midhaha, iyo ubaxa
• Xoolaha, digaaga, iyo kalluumaysiga
• Maareynta cayayaanka iyo cudurada
• Talooyin ku saabsan cimilada iyo suuqa

Sideen kuu caawin karaa maanta?

agrivision.name: AgriVision
agrivision.tagline: Aqoonsiga iyo baadigoobka cudurada dhirta oo ku shaqeeya AI
agrivision.description: Falanqaynta sawirrada dhirta si loo aqoonsado cudurada, cayayaanka, iyo nafaqo yaraanta. Hel baadhitaan degdeg ah oo wata talooyin daaweyn iyo ka hortag.

isdaSoil.name: ISDA Ciidda
isdaSoil.tagline: Tilmaamaha ciidda iyo falanqaynta nafaqooyinka Afrika
isdaSoil.description: Hel macluumaad faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan ciidda oo ay ku jiraan pH, nitrojiin, foosfar, botasiyam, iyo nafaqooyin kale. Waxaa laga heli karaa guud ahaan Afrika oo leh tayada 30 mitir.

accuweather.name: AccuWeather
accuweather.tagline: Xaaladaha hadda jira iyo saadaasha cimilada caalamka
accuweather.description: Hel macluumaadka cimilada waqtiga dhabta ah oo ay ku jiraan heerkulka, qoyaanka, xawaaraha dabaysha, iyo roobka. Saadaal laga heli karo ilaa 15 maalmood.

gapWeather.name: GAP Cimilada
gapWeather.description: Saadaasha cimilada gaarka ah ee beeraha Kenya. Waxaa ka mid ah uumiga biyaha, shucaaca qoraxda, iyo saadaasha roobka oo loogu talagalay go'aamada beerashada.

edacap.name: EDACaP Cimilada
edacap.description: Saadaasha cimilada xilliyada oo ay ku jiraan saadaasha heerkulka iyo roobka. Waxay ka caawisaa beeralayda inay qorsheeyaan jadwalada beerashada iyo goosashada.

weatherapi.name: WeatherAPI
weatherapi.tagline: Macluumaadka cimilada ee goobaha caalamiga ah
weatherapi.description: Adeeg macluumaad cimiladeed oo dhamaystiran oo bixiya xaaladaha hadda jira iyo saadaalinta goobaha adduunka oo dhan.

tomorrowIo.name: Tomorrow.io
tomorrowIo.description: Madal sirdoonka cimilada oo horumarsan oo leh saadaal tayo sare leh iyo awoodo saadaalin degdeg ah.

feedFormulation.name: Diyaarinta Cuntada Xoolaha
feedFormulation.tagline: Xisaabinta cuntada ugu haboon lo'da caanaha
feedFormulation.description: Xisaabi isku-darka cuntada ugu jaban ee lo'da caanahaaga. Waxay tixgelinaysaa yoolalka wax-soo-saarka caanaha, miisaanka jirka, iyo quudka deegaanka ee la heli karo.

nextgen.name: NextGen Bacriminta
nextgen.tagline: Talooyinka bacriminta ee goob-gaar ah oo Itoobiya ah
nextgen.description: Hel talooyin bacrimin oo sax ah oo ku salaysan goobtaada saxda ah. Waxay ka kooban tahay talooyin bacrimin dabiici ah (compost, vermicompost) iyo kuwo aan dabiici ahayn (Urea, NPS).

decisionTree.name: Geedka Go'aanka Dalagga
decisionTree.description: Hel talooyinka maaraynta dalagga oo ku salaysan marxaladda koritaanka iyo xaaladaha cimilada hadda jira. Waxay kaa caawisaa inaad go'aano wakhtigooda ku gaadho xakamaynta cayayaanka, waraabka, iyo goosashada.

gapAgriculture.name: GAP Beeraha
gapAgriculture.description: Adeegyada talo-siinta beeraha ee guud ee maaraynta dalagga iyo xoolaha.
